posts.text: A glTF file, Three.js and WebGL on the viewer's own GPU. No plugin, no video stream, no server drawing frames. Here is the full path of one rigged character, from a sentence to a lit, animated model in a browser tab, in six stages.

media.alt: The lighthouse keeper, a rigged three.ws character in a long yellow oilskin coat, navy knitted cap and black rubber boots, standing in the live glTF viewer under studio lighting

posts.text: To start, make. The Forge turns text or an image into a mesh with open models running on our own Cloud Run GPUs: TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D and TripoSG. Draft is about 12,000 polygons, Standard about 30,000 with 2K textures, High up to 200,000 polygons with full PBR.

Next, pack and load. The file is compressed for the wire, then the browser decodes it with Draco, KTX2 and meshopt through GLTFLoader, using same-origin decoders loaded on demand. The free validator checks the result against the Khronos suite, in your browser.

media.alt: The three.ws glTF validator page reporting the result of a Khronos validation run in the browser

posts.text: Then light. Lighting from a PMREM environment map, a three-point rig and Khronos PBR-Neutral tone mapping, so colours stay true to the material. Holo Sticker turns the same lit model into a shareable card.

media.alt: The three.ws Holo Sticker page showing a lit 3D character rendered live in the browser

posts.text: Then motion. A canonicalizer maps the bone names of Mixamo, VRM, Unreal, Rigify, Daz and more to one set, so a single clip library drives any humanoid. Faces move through ARKit morph targets with nine-viseme lip sync. Pose Studio lets you keyframe your own.

media.alt: The three.ws Animation Studio with a posable mannequin, bone list, pose presets and a keyframe timeline

posts.text: Last, embed. One script tag and one element put the character on any website. Rig Doctor, free and in your browser, tells you before you start whether your own avatar will animate.

media.alt: Rig Doctor: a page that diagnoses whether a GLB will animate, with a drop zone and sample rigs

posts.text: The long version has the embed code, the decoder and boot-phase tables, all partners by exact designation, how changes ship, and what is next: three.ws/viewer
